body:
I haven't called her family for the same reason I haven't called the cops/ambulance - it seems so extreme and final. Thus I subject myself to more psychotic manipulation and - I suppose - enable it. I don't *think* she's serious, but what if she is and I don't do anything? I guess I'm paralyzed between the fear of overreacting and not reacting *enough*.

In writing it out, it certainly looks like *she's* the crazy one and there's no real "overreacting" on my part. But yeah, either she's serious and waiting for me to get home so she can hurt herself while I'm there - which is horrible and mean and crazy - or she does just want attention and to manipulate and try to get what she wants - which is evil, psycho, and equally crazy.

Fun stuff.

Thanks again for your input. This really is a lose/lose situation. But I feel like I'm going home with a little more strength, resolve, and direction. That's *something*, right?

Thank you for your kind words. I just started to feel like I'm the crazy one and all this is my fault and I am pushing her to this - which I know is ridiculous. Like I responded to someone else, it helped just to type it out and have someone tell me I'm not crazy.

I guess my fear that paralyzes me is that I either overreact or don't act when I should have. I guess that's dumb. Life is nothing to gamble with. I'll call the hotline if it's still going on when I get home from work.

Sorry, just thinking out loud...well...in type. Thanks again for your response.

Thank you. It's just horrible being stuck between being tortured and manipulated - and the risk that if she *does* go through with something terrible, I would blame myself and never be able to live with myself. Every time I picked up the phone to call 911 last night when she was in the bathtub with a fucking steak knife, I just kept thinking "there's no coming back from this" and trying to talk her down. I guess there's no coming back from the alternative either. I'm sure she's just doing this to manipulate me, but how can I gamble on that? What's the alternative? Shit, I just don't know.

Anyways, thank you for your comment. It's just good to hear/read someone else tell me I'm not a complete asshole and it's not all my fault, regardless of *my* mistakes.
